plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
AUDIT COMMITTEE 
SPECIAL MEETING  
 
6:00 PM, NOVEMBER 4, 2026 
 
 
 
Committee Members: 
Present - Katie Kiely, Council President 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Leader 
Absent - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Present - Rhonda Caldwell 
Alternates 
Present - Sean Cardwell, Pro Tem 
Absent - Tasha Hunt, Majority Whip 
Present - Tom Figlar, Minority Whip 
 
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Chair Gallagher called the meeting to order at 6:15pm with the members noted above in 
attendance.  Council member Caldwell arrived after roll. 
 
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
Three members of the public came forward to give public comment.  Public input was 
closed at 6:20pm. 
  
3. INFORMATION ITEMS 
1. Progress Update from the Administration 
Items remained unchanged from the prior report.   
 
2. Distressed Municipality Roundtable 
Joe Geary – Chief of Staff to Waterbury Mayors Jarjura, O’Leary and Pernerewski 
Michael Milone – MARB representative to the City of West Haven 
The Committee heard presentations from Joe Geary, representing his experience with the 
City of Waterbury, and Michael Milone, representing his experience with the City of West 
Haven, regarding their municipalities' experiences with State financial oversight and 
assistance. Discussion included the circumstances leading to State intervention, the 
extent of State oversight, financial assistance, and the impact on municipal operations and 
local decision-making. Members also discussed Hamden's financial challenges, including 
debt service, tax burden, and potential opportunities for State assistance. 
 
Adam Cloud, Treasurer of the City of Hartford, was unable to attend due to illness. His 
participation will be rescheduled for a future meeting. 
 
4. ACTION ITEMS 
  1. Approval of Minutes from the October 21st meeting. 
Motion: Figlar 
Second: Kiely 
Vote:  0 opposed, 0 abstentions – all in favor. 
  
5. UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
There was no unfinished business for this evening’s meeting. 
 
6. NEW BUSINESS
1. Expected Due Dates for Next Meeting 
The next meeting is scheduled for November 18, 2026, at 7:00pm.  Vice Chair Alston 
requested the meeting start time be switched to 7:00pm going forward.  All were in 
agreement.   
  2. Additional Items 
There were no additional items added to the evening’s agenda. 
  
7. ADJOURNMENT  
Council member Figlar made a motion to adjourn, and the meeting was adjourned at 
approximately 8:30pm.
